## Alira assistant - NLU health
Built from the `customEvents` the API emits. Utterances and terms are redacted: company names show as `[COMPANY]`, figures as `[NUM]`. Full utterances are only in `ALIRA_DW.ASSISTANT.NLU_FEEDBACK`, reviewed by the data steward.

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "UnmappedTerm"
| summarize Hits = count(), LastSeen = max(timestamp)
        by Term = tostring(customDimensions.detected_term),
           Category = tostring(customDimensions.detected_category)
| order by Hits desc
content.title: Unmapped vocabulary - weekly synonym backlog

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "QueryRouted"
| extend Practice = tostring(customDimensions.practice),
         Conf = todouble(customDimensions.confidence)
| summarize P50 = percentile(Conf, 50), P10 = percentile(Conf, 10), Queries = count()
        by Practice, bin(timestamp, 1d)
content.title: Routing confidence by practice (P50 / P10) - watch for drift

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "QueryRouted" and toint(customDimensions.row_count) == 0
| project timestamp,
          Practice = tostring(customDimensions.practice),
          Intent = tostring(customDimensions.intent),
          Outcome = tostring(customDimensions.outcome),
          TraceId = tostring(customDimensions.trace_id)
| order by timestamp desc
content.title: Zero-row answers - the silent failure mode
